scenes.tts: Most pathways you have met work by adding something, such as a phosphate or a second messenger. Hedgehog works the other way. It tells the cells of an embryo where they are by switching off an off-switch. To follow it, you need one piece of logic. That logic is called a double negative.
scenes.visual: A switch flips on when a gold phosphate lands on it. Then Hedgehog appears; its direct arrow to the switch is drawn and crossed out. Instead a red bar from Hedgehog stops an off-switch chip, which in turn bars the switch. The two bars pulse and the words double negative appear.
scenes.narration: Most pathways you have met work by adding something, such as a phosphate or a second messenger. Hedgehog works the other way. It tells the cells of an embryo where they are by switching off an off-switch. To follow it, you need one piece of logic. That logic is called a double negative.

scenes.tts: Two proteins in the membrane of the receiving cell receive the signal. Patched is a brake, and Smoothened is the protein that it keeps off. With no Hedgehog, Patched is active, so Smoothened is off. Patched does not hold Smoothened. One Patched can keep many Smoothened molecules quiet.
scenes.visual: A membrane bar. Patched and Smoothened appear in it. With a dashed no-Hedgehog slot above, Patched shows ON and a red brake arc ends just short of Smoothened, which shows OFF. Smoothened slides on its own to show it is not held. Three more Smoothened appear, each with its own brake arc from the one Patched.
scenes.narration: Two proteins in the membrane of the receiving cell receive the signal. Patched is a brake, and Smoothened is the protein that it keeps off. With no Hedgehog, Patched is active, so Smoothened is off. Patched does not hold Smoothened. One Patched can keep many Smoothened molecules quiet.

scenes.tts: Now Hedgehog arrives and binds Patched, the brake. Hedgehog does not press the accelerator. It releases the handbrake. Patched is switched off, so Smoothened is on. Hedgehog switches off the protein that keeps Smoothened off, and that is the double negative.
scenes.visual: The same membrane picture. The Hedgehog slot fills and Hedgehog drops onto Patched. A crossed-out accelerator arrow to Smoothened. Patched dims, the brake arcs retract, Patched shows OFF and every Smoothened turns ON with a green ring. A chain Hedgehog, Patched, Smoothened with two red bars builds underneath.
scenes.narration: Now Hedgehog arrives and binds Patched, the brake. Hedgehog does not press the accelerator. It releases the handbrake. Patched is switched off, so Smoothened is on. Hedgehog switches off the protein that keeps Smoothened off, and that is the double negative.

scenes.tts: The pathway ends at a transcription factor called Glee. With Smoothened off, kinases add phosphates to Glee, and ubiquitin tags it for the proteasome. The proteasome destroys only its back part, which holds the activating region. The front part still binds D N A, and as a repressor it keeps the Hedgehog target genes off. With Smoothened on, the marking stops, and Glee stays whole and becomes an activator.
scenes.caption: The pathway ends at a transcription factor called Gli. With Smoothened off, kinases add phosphates to Gli, and ubiquitin tags it for the proteasome. The proteasome destroys only its back part, which holds the activating region. The front part still binds DNA, and as a repressor it keeps the Hedgehog target genes off. With Smoothened on, the marking stops, and Gli stays whole and becomes an activator.
scenes.visual: A long Gli bar with a front and a back part. With Smoothened OFF, gold phosphates and a ubiquitin tag land on it and a proteasome chip sits on the back part, which fades to a dashed ghost. The front piece drops onto a target genes bar that reads OFF. Then Smoothened turns ON, a whole fresh Gli bar drops onto the bar and it reads ON.
scenes.narration: The pathway ends at a transcription factor called Gli. With Smoothened off, kinases add phosphates to Gli, and ubiquitin tags it for the proteasome. The proteasome destroys only its back part, which holds the activating region. The front part still binds DNA, and as a repressor it keeps the Hedgehog target genes off. With Smoothened on, the marking stops, and Gli stays whole and becomes an activator.

scenes.tts: In vertebrates, this pathway runs at the primary cilium. Many kinds of cell carry one, a single hair-like projection that does not beat. Without Hedgehog, Patched sits at the cilium and Smoothened stays out. When Hedgehog binds, Patched leaves and Smoothened moves in. Glee proteins gathered at the tip of the cilium are sent to the nucleus as activators.

scenes.visual: A cell with one tall cilium. Patched sits in the cilium wall, Smoothened sits on the cell body outside. Hedgehog binds Patched; Patched leaves down the wall onto the cell body while Smoothened moves up into the cilium. Gli chips at the tip travel to the nucleus.

scenes.tts: Now use that logic to predict what happens when a part of the pathway is lost. With no Patched, nothing restrains Smoothened, so the pathway is on, with or without Hedgehog. With no Smoothened, nothing passes the signal on, so the pathway is off both ways. With neither protein the pathway is off as well, because the later step decides. So ask what state Smoothened is in, and everything after it follows.
scenes.visual: The membrane picture with a pathway lamp. Patched is removed to a dashed ghost: the lamp goes ON and stays ON while Hedgehog comes and goes. Patched returns and Smoothened is removed: the lamp is OFF both ways. Both removed: OFF. Then the intact picture returns with a ring on Smoothened and the question What state is Smoothened in.
